Here’s a radical idea. 

Charge every cop who punches/kicks a “suspect” who is already on the floor with assault. 

#DefundThePolice #BlackLivesMatter

Here’s another radical idea. 

Fire every cop who has been videotaped using any amount of excessive force. 

#DefundThePolice #BlackLivesMatter

And another one. 

Make it illegal to hire a cop who has more than one excessive force complaint, or who has been videotaped using excessive force - for any position related to policing, security or military, nationwide.

#DefundThePolice #BlackLivesMatter

One more. 

Create an oversight committee of civilians (from both sides of the political spectrum) to review and decide on all police excessive force cases. We pay their salaries, we should have a say in what is deemed excessive. 

#DefundThePolice #BlackLivesMatter

Okay maybe another one.

Make all police academies provide a minimum of 2 years of schooling with an emphasis on non-violent interventions and deescalation. 

#DefundThePolice #BlackLivesMatter

Okay, last one.

All mental health or wellness checks should be lead by social workers or nurses. Not police officers. 

#DefundThePolice #BlackLivesMatter

Okay that’s it for now but I’ll probably add to this thread again at some point. 

In the meantime...

#JusticeForRegis #JusticeForBreonna #StopKillingUs #BlackLivesMatter #IndigenousLivesMatter #SayHerName #DefundThePolice #AbolishThePolice #AbolishICE #Vote2020
